name: Thotar
summary: Thotar is a seasoned orc hunter trainer stationed in the settlement of Razor Hill in Durotar. He guides aspiring Horde scouts and marksmen in the ancient traditions of tracking, archery, and bonding with wild beasts. For young orcs and trolls taking their first steps outside the Valley of Trials, he provides the foundational rites needed to master Kalimdor's rugged fauna.

sections.title: A Mentor in Razor Hill
sections.body: Perched within the fortified hub of Razor Hill, Thotar serves as a veteran instructor for marksmen of the Horde. While new recruits learn the very basics in the Valley of Trials, it falls to Thotar to guide hunters as they face the harsher predatory wilderness of Durotar. Drawing upon traditions passed down through countless generations of orcs, he teaches not only marksmanship, but the deeper respect required to live alongside and direct Kalimdor's deadliest creatures.

sections.title: Taming the Wilds
sections.body: Thotar plays a crucial role in introducing young hunters to the ancient art of beast taming. Through a sequence of trials, he sends novices into the arid canyons to pacify and commune with native beasts, such as venomous scorpid, savage crocolisks, and cunning boars. By guiding these young scouts through the sacred rites of taming, Thotar ensures the Horde's trackers build a loyal bond with nature rather than merely attempting to dominate it by force.

faq.answer: Thotar is a veteran orc hunter trainer stationed in Razor Hill in Durotar. He educates young hunters in traditional wilderness lore, marksmanship, and animal taming.
He is located in the Horde settlement of Razor Hill, situated in central Durotar just north of the Valley of Trials.

Thotar teaches the ancient survival and tracking traditions passed down through generations of orcs. He emphasizes weapon mastery, wilderness survival, and learning to bond with animal companions through patience and ritual.

While he is an orc steeped in his people's ways, Thotar instructs any hunter aligned with the Horde who arrives in Razor Hill, regularly mentoring Darkspear trolls and wandering tauren passing through Durotar.

faq.q: What tasks does Thotar give to young hunters?
aliases: what does thotar send you to do
faq.answer: Thotar directs novice hunters on the rites of 'Taming the Beast,' tasking them with tracking down native Durotar wildlife—such as scorpids and crocolisks—and using a taming rod to earn their trust and obedience.

faq.q: Why is beast taming so important in his training?
faq.answer: For Horde hunters, a beast companion is a vital partner on the battlefield and in the wild. Thotar teaches that properly bonding with a beast ensures mutual survival, transforming raw predators into loyal defenders of the Horde.

angles.text: Thotar represents a key milestone for young Horde hunters, teaching the vital rites of beast taming and wilderness mastery once novices step out of the starter valleys.
Thotar preserves and passes down traditional orcish hunting customs, ensuring that life on Kalimdor remains anchored in deep ancestral respect for tracking and beast companionship.
For Darkspear hunters setting out from Sen'jin Village, Thotar offers vital instruction that blends ancestral Horde survival skills with the predatory challenges of Durotar.
As a frontline trainer in Razor Hill, Thotar ensures that scouts and marksmen patrolling Durotar's borders are disciplined, sharp-eyed, and well-bonded with combat beasts.
